create_PROBINGEval: create a PROBINGEval instance to load and run a probing classification task on sentence embeddings
run_PROBINGEval: run PROBINGEval to compute embeddings and evaluate a probing classifier on train/dev/test splits
create_LengthEval: create a LengthEval instance to probe sentence length prediction from learned representations
create_TenseEval: create a TenseEval instance to probe tense classification (past/present) from learned representations
create_DepthEval: create a DepthEval instance to probe syntactic tree depth prediction from learned representations
